newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy to issue 2.75 mln shares. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT 25/1]
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy to issue 2.75 mln shares. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT 25/1]

text.p: El Paso Natural Gas Co, which does business as El Paso Energy Corp, said Thursday it planned to offer 2.75 million shares of common stock.

"The offering is one of the final steps in the company's refinancing plan following its acquisition of Tenneco Energy last December," it said, adding that proceeds from the offering would help reduce debt associated with the acquisition.
El Paso said it will grant its underwriters an overallotment option to purchase up to an additional 412,500 shares.
The company acquired Tenneco Energy for $4 billion when Tenneco Inc restructured its ownership in various units.
At the end of the fourth quarter, El Paso had 55.3 million (corrects from 39.6 million) shares against 34.2 million a year ago.
